top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a simple one-parameter model (Bistritzer-MacDonald) that made a sharp, falsifiable prediction of flat bands at a magic twist angle, which experiment then confirmed with correlated insulating and superconducting states, since reproduced by independent groups and extended to multilayer and TMD moire platforms. The discovery does not depend on the unsettled pairing mechanism, and the theory-plus-experiment trio fits the three-name limit, though the omission of Yuan Cao and the short track record are real costs. P002 is a clean, well-attributed, cross-checked fallback but a refinement of the lineage honoured in 2005 and 2012; both are better than no award.
